method.disclosures: Publication date from provider metadata, not independently audited original PDF. Entry at close of the first full IHSG session strictly after publication date; 5/20-session price response versus same-date IHSG. Intraday timestamp/timezone availability unverified. Overlapping disclosure events are not pooled into a strategy or causal effect.
method.analog: Same issuer, same close/SMA50/SMA200 regime and Z20 bucket (<-1, -1..1, >1) as latest observation. Features use only current/past data. 20-session horizon, next-session close entry. Candidates spaced >21 sessions; selection/cooldown before outcome guards. Only matured, complete positive-price/volume paths, no >40% jumps. Historical matched conditions, not a forecast.
method.evaluation: Chronological quarterly monitoring of fixed net-buy-positive/Z20>=2 events from Screener, next-close entry, non-overlap. Prior sample counts include only events whose 20D exit precedes the quarter. No fitted model or genuine prospective holdout: retrospective fixed-rule walk-forward diagnostic, not validated alpha.
method.cost: 0/10/25 bps per side on both issuer and same-date IHSG proxy: (1+gross)*(1-c)/(1+c)-1. These are sensitivity assumptions, not observed execution fees. No leverage, dividends, impact or executable index product.
method.limits: Current LQ45 membership, not historical membership; raw price adjustment unverified. Small dependent samples; Wilson hit-rate CI is exploratory, not return CI or prediction probability. Report snapshot values are not historical features. Filings response is provider text, not independently audited source-document content. No legal clearance inferred.

corporate_actions.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, audited consolidated financial statements including 2023-2024 restatements, and granted a discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners. The resolution notes that management remains liable for any proven legal violations or undisclosed actions during their tenure, particularly regarding ongoing investigations by the SEC and DOJ.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a total cash dividend of Rp21,999,902,180,685, representing a 123.5% payout ratio sourced from the 2025 net profit and retained earnings. The Board of Directors is authorized to manage the payment schedule, taxation, and technical implementation.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to determine the 2026 salaries, benefits, and 2025 performance-based remuneration for the company's management. This covers compensation for both the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners, subject to Series B Shareholder approval, was authorized to appoint a Public Accounting Firm to audit the 2026 consolidated financial statements and the Micro and Small Business Funding Program. This authority includes setting audit fees and appointing replacements if the primary auditor cannot complete the task.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved a share buyback program with a maximum budget of Rp4,000,000,000,000, including all related execution costs and regulatory compliance. The Board of Directors is authorized to implement or terminate the program in accordance with prevailing regulations.
Agenda #6: The meeting delegated authority to the Board of Commissioners, with written approval from Series B Shareholders, to approve the 2026-2030 Long-Term Plan (RJPP) and the 2027 Work Plan and Budget (RKAP). The process must align with good corporate governance and government policy synchronization.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved amendments to the Articles of Association to align business activities with KBLI 2025 and reclassify 516,023,535 Series B shares into Series A Dwiwarna shares. The Board of Directors was granted authority to execute all necessary legal and notarial documentation to finalize these changes.
Agenda #8: The meeting approved the dismissal of Rionald Silaban and Silmy Karim and appointed Edwin Hidayat Abdullah as Commissioner and Anthony Leong as Independent Commissioner. The new management composition was established with a nine-member Board of Directors led by Dian Siswarini and an eight-member Board of Commissioners led by Angga Raka Prabowo.

broker.reason: Ranking deskriptif hanya untuk kode broker dalam arsip lokal. Hash file cocok dengan inventaris, tetapi endpoint asal belum tercatat dan cakupan bukan seluruh broker. Kode broker bukan identitas pemilik manfaat.
broker.method: Net = sum(bval) − sum(sval). Pembeli: net positif terbesar; penjual: net negatif terbesar secara absolut. Periode memakai tanggal record yang tersedia pada semua kode broker; missing tidak diisi nol. Porsi = (beli+jual broker)/sum(beli+jual seluruh broker dalam sampel), bukan pangsa seluruh pasar; transaksi antarbroker dapat terhitung pada kedua sisi.
